title: Bitmap Slot Allocator
shortDescription: Manage 32 fixed resources with a compact allocation bitmap.

templates.notes: Use bit operations; the harness checks boundary handling and reuse.

visibleCases.name: fresh allocator
visibleCases.displayExpect:
slots_used_count(&slots) = 0
slots_is_used(&slots, i) = false for every i in [0, 31]

visibleCases.name: allocates lowest slots
visibleCases.displayExpect:
a = 0
b = 1
c = 2
slots_is_used(&slots, 0) = true
slots_is_used(&slots, 1) = true
slots_is_used(&slots, 2) = true
slots_used_count(&slots) = 3
visibleCases.explanation: First-fit should return the lowest free index.

visibleCases.name: free and reuse
visibleCases.explanation: Freeing clears the corresponding bitmap bit.

hiddenCases.name: full allocator
hiddenCases.displayInput: allocate all slots plus one extra
hiddenCases.explanation: No slot exists after all 32 bits are set.

hiddenCases.name: invalid free ignored
hiddenCases.explanation: Out-of-range slots must not corrupt state.

hiddenCases.name: double free safe
hiddenCases.displayInput: free the same allocated slot twice
hiddenCases.explanation: Clearing an already-clear bit should be harmless.
